messages.text:
"Create a game based of \"The Binding of Isaac\". Make a character capable of moving around a room and shoot tears in the four directions, make a map that generates rooms proceduraly, there's various grotesque monsters and enemies in the rooms such as spiders, flies, meat, worms, ghosts, etc. There's an special rooms that's only connected with one another, it contains an special item player can pick up and increase their damage, fire rate, range, shot speed, movement speed, health, etc. The player has 3 heart containers which can be filled upon obtaining health by an item (which also adds another full container) or picking up hearts from the floor. The most away from the initial room, there's a boss room with a boss. When clearing a room, there can be a reward that's either a key, a coin or a heart. When clearing the boss room, another item spawns as reward, and a trapdoor to the next floor also appears. Treasure rooms have to be opened using a key. There can also spawn a shop room each floor, that sells keys or hearts for five coins or an item for fifteen coins. Give the game dynamism and make many different possible bosses and enemies, each two floors the aesthetic of the level changes and there are new possible bosses and enemies to appear there. Give the game a pixel art, kinda cute but grotesque style, and make the ambience music dramatic but some harmony.
"
